archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Adapted for SaaS with High-Contrast Performance Pro traits)
design_philosophy: A modern, soft-UI dark mode workspace mimicking a physical control canvas. Heavily relies on deep obsidian backgrounds, pure glassmorphism (crystal variant), and glowing electric orange accents. The UI eschews rigid grids in favor of free-floating panels anchored around the edges over a dark architectural floorplan map, maximizing the negative space and creating an immersive command-center feel.

global.app_shell: flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white selection:bg-orange-500/30
global.sidebar: w-[80px] h-full flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center py-6 border-r border-white/10 z-50 bg-[#0A0A0A]/85 backdrop-blur-xl
global.topbar: h-[64px] w-full flex items-center justify-between px-8 border-b border-white/10 z-40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl absolute top-0 left-0

panel_system.base_classes: absolute bg-[#141414]/65 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-[20px] p-6 overflow-hidden flex flex-col gap-4

components_instructions.app_shell: Ensure the layout is fixed. Use a flex row where Sidebar is the first child (w-[80px]), and a flex column container takes the remaining width. The Topbar sits fixed at the top of the main container, and the Canvas fills the rest.
components_instructions.sidebar: Navigation links are icon-only (e.g., using lucide-react). Structure: Logo at top, primary nav icons in the middle grouped with gap-6, user settings icon at bottom. Active item gets a rounded-xl bg-white/10 highlight or an orange glow.
components_instructions.topbar: Glass effect is critical. Left section: Page title using Outfit font. Center: A sleek search bar with a subtle border and bg-white/5. Right: Date/time display and User profile image.
components_instructions.workspace_canvas: This container is relative. Include an absolute background image taking up inset-0 with object-cover, mix-blend-luminosity, and opacity-30. On top of that, add a full div overlay with bg-black/70 to ensure contrast. Panel components go inside the canvas layer.
components_instructions.floating_panels: Build a `WorkspacePanel` wrapper component that accepts a `position` prop mapped to the absolute positioning classes. Avoid standard rows/columns inside panels—use dense UI with crisp tiny labels (caption styling) and glowing values.
components_instructions.buttons: Primary CTA uses bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-colors. Secondary/ghost buttons use hover:bg-white/10.
components_instructions.data_testid: Apply meaningful `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, panel wrappers, inputs, and nav icons (e.g., `data-testid='panel-top-left'`).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements scale slightly or change background opacity. Buttons: `transition-all duration-200 ease-out`.
motion_and_interactions.panel_entry: Panels should use framer-motion to enter. `initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}`. Stagger the entry of the 5 positions for a staggered loading effect.
motion_and_interactions.focus: Inputs and buttons must have `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/50 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-black`.

workspace_map.description: Architectural floorplan used as the main deep background layer of the canvas.

brand_icon.description: Abstract orange soundwave texture used as the Clara brand icon in the sidebar top.

profile.description: Radio broadcaster portrait for the user profile in the topbar.
